name: 役割とメンバーへの権限追加
prompt:
Create the second render of this same Japanese “new permission” component. Use the native preview as the exact authority; use v001 only as the correction target. Preserve the 390x168 white canvas, heading 「新しい権限」, both exact action labels 「役割を追加」「メンバーを追加」, dark label color, green outline-plus color and weight, row heights, text sizes, separators and all vertical positions. Do not change any content or styling.

In v001 the layout, labels, line positions and icon sizes already match the native preview closely. The only visible residual is that each plus icon is centered about 2px too far right. Move both plus icons left by approximately 2px so their centers align near x356 like the native image. Keep their current size, stroke and color, and keep the two labels at x16. Preserve the quiet white background and extra bottom margin after the lower divider.

This crop has no hyperlinks. Both labels are action controls, so keep them dark; apply blue only to actual linked text when one is present. The original source’s blue Edit control is outside the selected crop and must not be added. Do not alter anything else or introduce cards, fills, shadows, extra icons, avatars or screen chrome.
